description: Scaffolds a PARA-style Obsidian vault for a software engineering project — folders, Obsidian Bases (database views), note templates, an AGENTS.md briefing, plus (when a spec/brief is provided) atomized notes broken out by risk, open question, architecture section, etc. Use when the user wants an Obsidian vault for a software project, asks to convert a project spec/brief into a navigable structure with discrete linked notes, requests a PARA scaffold, or wants to add a project to an existing vault. Trigger even without explicit "Obsidian" mention when the intent is clearly to organize a software project's docs into atomized notes — "set up a workspace for this spec" or "turn this spec into something I can actually navigate" qualify. Do NOT trigger for — summarizing specs in chat, format conversions (Word/PDF), knowledge bases for non-project content (customer research, interviews, articles), personal note-taking, fixing Bases syntax, scaffolding source code, or single-note additions to existing vaults.
